|errata_history=This is a playtest image (9 April 2025), published before the set's official release (8 August 2025); the PC replaced it before release. The current text is [[Blast Points (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Under Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026 pre-release images are Playtest versions; the original printing is [[Blast Points (V)]]. The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Playtest''' (this page): Playtest image: PC card image of 9 April 2025<ref name="ht-bp-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e3a0f34/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/blastpoints.gif blastpoints.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e3a0f34 e3a0f34] (9 April 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. Virtual Set 25 preview card (published before the 8 August 2025 release). Text: “Take Ghhhk or Hyperwave Scan into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If you just won a battle, cancel Cloud City Celebration or Tatooine Celebration. OR If opponent just looked at cards in their Force Pile or Used Pile, peek at the top 2 cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand.”
* '''Original''' ([[Blast Points (V)]]): PC card image of 11 April 2025<ref name="ht-bp-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/0c156d8/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/blastpoints.gif blastpoints.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/0c156d8 0c156d8] (11 April 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: “If opponent just looked at cards in their Force Pile or Used Pile” becomes “If opponent just looked at one or more cards in their Force Pile or Used Pile”. Text: “Take Ghhhk or Hyperwave Scan into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If you just won a battle, cancel Cloud City Celebration or Tatooine Celebration. OR If opponent just looked at one or more cards in their Force Pile or Used Pile, peek at the top 2 cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata). 
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Blast Points (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 10 August 2025: “Take Ghhhk or Hyperwave Scan into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If you just won a battle, cancel Cloud City Celebration or Tatooine Celebration. OR If opponent just looked at one or more cards in their Force Pile or Used Pile, peek at the top 2 cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Blast Points (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Blast Points”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Blast Points (V)]] (published 11 April 2025) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Blast Points]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
